name: djlint
description: HTML template formatter and linter (Django, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Liquid, Go templates, Mustache, Tera, Askama)

djlint.blankLineAfterTag.markdownDescription: Add an additional blank line after `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Blank lines are never added to the end of a block. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.blankLineBeforeTag.markdownDescription: Add an additional blank line before `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Blank lines are never added to the start of a file or block, or between similar tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.closeVoidTags.markdownDescription: Add a closing mark to known void tags, so that `` becomes ``. Requires djLint ≥ 1.26.

djlint.configuration.description: Path to the configuration file. The path can be relative to the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.13 for .djlintrc format and ≥ 1.34 for TOML.

djlint.customBlocks.markdownDescription: Indent custom code blocks, for example `{% toc %}...{% endtoc %}`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.customHtml.markdownDescription: Indent custom HTML tags, for example `<mjml>`, `<simple-greeting>` or `<mj-\w+>`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.enableLinting.description: Lint for common issues. Don't enable globally, instead enable for each language individually.

djlint.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the djLint executable. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Used when `#djlint.useVenv#` is disabled, before falling back to `#djlint.pythonPath#`.

djlint.exclude.description: Override the default exclude paths. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.extendExclude.description: Add additional paths to the default exclude. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJson.markdownDescription: Format JavaScript and JSON code inside HTML attributes, such as `onclick`, `x-*` and other JavaScript-related attributes. Objects with fewer properties than `#djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonMinProps#` are left on a single line. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonMinProps.description: Minimum number of properties a JavaScript/JSON object must have to be formatted. Objects with fewer properties stay on a single line. Leave unset for djLint's default of 2. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonPattern.markdownDescription: Regex matching the attributes to format as JavaScript. Leave empty for djLint's default, which matches common JavaScript attributes such as `onclick` and `x-*`, along with Vue.js, Alpine.js and Angular directives. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.

djlint.formatAttributeTemplateTags.description: Attempt to format template syntax inside of tag attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.formatCss.markdownDescription: Also format the contents of `<style>` tags, using css-beautify. Template syntax inside them is not fully supported. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.

djlint.formatLanguages.description: Language IDs for which djLint should be registered as a formatter.

djlint.formatJs.markdownDescription: Also format the contents of `<script>` tags, using js-beautify. Template syntax inside them is not fully supported. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.

djlint.ignore.description: Linter codes to ignore. Requires djLint ≥ 0.1.5.

djlint.ignoreBlocks.description: Template blocks whose children are not indented. The children are treated as siblings of the block and indented accordingly. Requires djLint ≥ 1.24.

djlint.ignoreCase.description: Do not attempt to fix the case of known html tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.23.

djlint.include.description: Linter codes to include. Requires djLint ≥ 1.20.

djlint.indentCss.markdownDescription: Indent width for the contents of `<style>` tags, used when `#djlint.formatCss#` is enabled. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.indentJs.markdownDescription: Indent width for the contents of `<script>` tags, used when `#djlint.formatJs#` is enabled. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.keepBrInline.markdownDescription:
Keep `
` on the line of the text it breaks, rather than giving it a line of its own. `
` is unaffected. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.lineBreakAfterMultilineTag.description: Do not condense the content of multi-line tags into the line of the last attribute. Requires djLint ≥ 1.27.

djlint.maxAttributeLength.description: Attempt to wrap tag attributes once the attribute length exceeds this value. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.maxBlankLines.description: Consolidate blank lines down to this many lines. Leave unset for djLint's default of 0, which removes blank lines. Requires djLint ≥ 1.31.

djlint.maxLineLength.description: Attempt to put some html and template tags on a single line instead of wrapping them, as long as the line does not exceed this length. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.nameEndblocks.markdownDescription: Write the block's name into the `{% endblock %}` that closes it, where the block is written across lines. This is what `T003` asks for. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.noEntityFormatting.markdownDescription: Do not rewrite an entity reference as the character it names, so `©` is left as written rather than becoming ©. The entities that carry syntax, and the invisible ones, are never rewritten either way. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.noFunctionFormatting.markdownDescription: Do not attempt to format the arguments of function calls inside `{{ }}` expressions. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.

djlint.noIndentInnerHtml.markdownDescription: Do not indent `<head>` and `<body>` below `<html>`, which is how the built-in VS Code HTML formatter lays a document out. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.noLineAfterYaml.description: Do not add a blank line after yaml front matter. Requires djLint ≥ 1.29.

djlint.noSetFormatting.markdownDescription: Do not attempt to format the contents of `{% set %}` tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.

djlint.preserveBlankLines.description: Preserve blank lines where possible. Ideal for non-html template files where blank lines are intentional. Requires djLint ≥ 1.3.

djlint.preserveClassNewlines.description: Preserve line breaks inside multiline class attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.39.

djlint.preserveLeadingSpace.description: Preserve leading space on text where possible. Ideal for non-html template files where text indent is intentional. Requires djLint ≥ 1.2.

enumDescriptions: Do not pass a profile, so djLint uses the one from your configuration file, or its own default.
Every template language at once. A rule that does not hold for one of them is skipped.
Jinja templates. Use this one for MiniJinja too.
Tera templates. Use this one for Zola too.
Askama templates, Jinja-style templates in Rust. Rust expressions are never reformatted.
Plain HTML, with no template syntax.
djlint.profile.markdownDescription: Set a profile for the template language. The profile enables the linter rules that apply to that language, and may also change reformatting. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.5; the `askama`, `tera` and `liquid` profiles require djLint ≥ 1.42, and `all` requires djLint ≥ 1.44.

djlint.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path to the desired Python interpreter. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Used as a fallback when `#djlint.useVenv#` is disabled and `#djlint.executablePath#` is not available.
djlint.pythonPath.markdownDeprecationMessage: Prefer `#djlint.executablePath#` for direct djLint executables. `#djlint.pythonPath#` remains available as a Python fallback.

enumDescriptions: Do not pass a quote style, so djLint uses the one from your configuration file, or its own default of double quotes.
djlint.quoteStyle.markdownDescription: Quotes to use for strings inside template tags. `T002` asks for the same quotes, and the formatter uses them in conditions such as `{% if x == "a" %}`, so one file does not spell the same string both ways. Quoting of HTML attributes is left to `H008`. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.requirePragma.markdownDescription: Only format or lint files that start with a comment with the text `djlint:on`. The comment can be an HTML comment or a comment in the template language given by `#djlint.profile#`. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.8.

djlint.rules.description: Path to a custom rules file in .djlint_rules.yaml format. The path can be relative to the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.41.

djlint.showInstallError.description: Show error message when djLint is not installed.

djlint.singleAttributePerLine.description: When an opening tag wraps, put the tag name, each attribute and the closing bracket on separate lines. Requires djLint ≥ 1.40.

djlint.sortAttributes.markdownDescription: Sort attributes by name, with `id` first and `class` second. A tag whose attributes are guarded by a template tag keeps the order it was written in, since moving one out of its branch would change the page. Requires djLint ≥ 1.45.

djlint.useEditorIndentation.markdownDescription: Get the number of indent spaces from VS Code (see the `#editor.tabSize#` setting). Disable to get it from the djLint config file. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.3.

djlint.useGitignore.description: Add .gitignore excludes to the default exclude. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.9.

djlint.useNewLinterOutputParser.markdownDescription: Use a new, more reliable linter output parser. If you disable this setting, make sure that you have not changed the `linter_output_format` setting in the djLint configuration file. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.useVenv.markdownDescription: Use the Python executable from the current active environment. When enabled, `#djlint.executablePath#` and `#djlint.pythonPath#` are ignored. Disable this to try `#djlint.executablePath#` (`djlint` from PATH by default) before falling back to `#djlint.pythonPath#`.
